user_actions.title: What is the "best" way to put a forum on "static" mode?
user_actions.excerpt:
This is a feature that I still view as quite important – the ability to switch a Discourse site entirely to static HTML “archived” mode for permanent storage long term, say, in the Internet Archive. 
We have something close to this with the web crawler view, so it’s not entirely far off..

user_actions.title: Federation support for Discourse
user_actions.excerpt:
Well, let’s make sure this is working at least. 
I’m still not totally sure federation makes sense for Discourse (paragraphs/stories) in quite the way that it does for Twitter (sentences/chat) but we should support it for those that want to try.
